concept.title: Seat warmer
concept.shortdesc: The seat warmer keeps the seats warm in cold weather.

conbody.p: With the vehicle in ON position:

li.p: Push either of the buttons to warm the driver’s seat or the front passenger’s seat.

conbody.p: During mild weather or under conditions where the operation of the seat warmer is not needed, keep the controls off.
The seat warmer defaults off whenever the vehicle is in ON position.

li.p: Each time you press the buttons, the temperature setting of the seat will change as follows:

section.title: Temperature control (automatic)
section.p: The seat warmer automatically controls the seat temperature to prevent low-temperature burns after being manually turned on.
Press the button to increase the seat temperature. It will revert to the automatic mode again after a short period of time.
Turn off the seat warmer by pressing the controls for more than 1.5 seconds.

note.p: Passengers should use extreme caution when using seat warmers due to the possibility of excess heating causing burns. The seat warmer may cause burns even at low temperatures, especially if used for long periods of time. The driver must exercise extreme care for the following types of passengers:

li.p: Infants, children, elderly, disabled persons, or hospital outpatients
Persons with sensitive skin or those that burn easily
Individuals taking medication that can cause drowsiness or sleepiness (sleeping pills, cold tablets, and so on).
When cleaning the seats, do not use an organic solvent such as paint thinner, benzene, alcohol, or gasoline. It may damage the surface of the warmer or seats.
To prevent overheating the seat warmer, do not place anything on the seats that insulate against heat, such as blankets, cushions, or seat covers while the seat warmer is in operation.
Do not place heavy or sharp objects on seats equipped with seat warmers. Damage to the seat warming components could occur.
Do not change the seat cover. It may damage the seat warmer or air ventilation system.

note.p: When the seat warmer controls are on, the heating system in the seat turns off or on automatically depending on the seat temperature.

section.title: Last mode
section.p: This function retains the temperature setting of the driver’s seat warmer and ventilated seat even after the vehicle is turned off and restarted.
For example, if the driver’s seat warmer was set to Level 3 (High) before the vehicle was turned off, it will automatically resume at Level 3 (High) when the vehicle is restarted.
Only the temperature settings of the driver’s seat warmer and ventilated seat are retained.

li.p: Select SetupVehicleSeatsSave Driver’s Seat Warmer/Ventilation Settings from the infotainment system.
Settings that are adjusted automatically will either not be saved or will revert to the state before the change.
If the seat warmer temperature level is lowered due to automatic adjustment and the vehicle is turned off, the system will save the level set before the automatic adjustment.

When the Smart Temperature Comfort Control system (driver’s seat) is activated, the temperature level will not be saved. For more information, refer to Smart temperature comfort control system (for driver’s seat).
